camel_example: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster AddMessageContact --region cn-hangzhou --MessageTypes.1 AccountExpenses --Title TechnicalDirector --EmailAddress 'someone000@example.com' --Name tom --method POST --force
kebab_example: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster add-message-contact --name tom --email-address someone000@example.com --title TechnicalDirector --message-types AccountExpenses --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddMessageContact

parameters.help_en:
The name of the contact.

The contact name must be unique within the resource directory.

Format: 2 to 12 characters in length, which can contain letters and Chinese characters
parameters.help_zh:
联系人的名称。

联系人的名称在资源目录内必须唯一。

格式：2~12个英文字母或汉字
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The email address of the contact.

After you add an email address, you must call [SendEmailVerificationForMessageContact](~~SendEmailVerificationForMessageContact~~) to send a verification message to the email address. The email address of the contact takes effect only after the verification is passed
parameters.help_zh:
联系人的邮箱地址。

添加邮箱地址后，您需要继续调用[SendEmailVerificationForMessageContact](~~SendEmailVerificationForMessageContact~~)向该邮箱地址发送验证信息，通过验证后，该联系人的邮箱地址才能生效
parameters.name: email_address

parameters.help_en:
The phone number of the contact.

Format: `<Country code>-<Phone number>`.

Only phone numbers in the Chinese mainland in the format `86-<Phone number>` are supported.

After you add a phone number, you must invoke [SendPhoneVerificationForMessageContact](~~SendPhoneVerificationForMessageContact~~) to send a verification message to the phone number. The phone number of the contact takes effect only after you authenticate it
parameters.help_zh:
联系人的手机号码。

格式：`<国家码>-<手机号码>`。

仅支持填写`86-<手机号码>`的中国内地手机号码。

添加手机号码后，您需要继续调用[SendPhoneVerificationForMessageContact](~~SendPhoneVerificationForMessageContact~~)向该手机号码发送验证信息，通过验证后，该联系人的手机号码才能生效
parameters.name: phone_number

parameters.help_en: The job title of the contact
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The message types that the contact receives
parameters.help_zh: 联系人接收的消息分类
parameters.name: message_types

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the contact was created. The time is in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format and does not contain a time zone identifier
CreateDate.description_zh: 联系人创建时间。时间格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss，不包含时区标识
